profile.headline: Lead Product Designer & Web Developer
profile.summary:
www.stephenwilli.com

Hello, I am a UX designer, front-end web developer and photographer based in Jackson, Wyoming. With over a decade of digital agency experience, I have worked on a wide variety of projects in the tourism, outdoor lifestyle and non-profit spaces. I focus on user centered design through research and prototyping, and create intuitive, interactive and responsive web and mobile experiences.

positions.title: Lead Product Designer & Web Developer
positions.description:
Projects include:
• WILD Fundation
• The Jacksonian
• Children's Learning Center

positions.title: UX Designer & Front-End Web Developer
positions.description:
Collaborated with a team of experts to deliver high-end web and mobile experiences for outdoor lifestyle, tourism and social good organizations. Primary responsibilities included user experience research, sitemapping, wireframing, front-end web development and creating custom Wordpress content management solutions.

Projects Included: 
• Jackson Hole Travel & Tourism Board
• The Rusty Parrot Lodge & Spa
• Protect our Water Jackson Hole
• Astoria Hot Springs Park
• The Cloudviell Hotel
• Alpenglow Expeditions
positions.insights: Skills: User Experience (UX) · Front-End Development · UX Design · Wordpress
